interactions.conditions: For the historical #90 A-to-B cable contract, J4 (board-a) pins 1-2 = +15V (Board A VBUS_OUT, post-Q1-load-switch, paired A->B conductors), 3 = ATT (STUSB4500 U1.11/ATTACH, open-drain active-low, no on-board pull-up), 4 = PDOK (STUSB4500 U1.20/POWER_OK2, open-drain active-low, asserts on a live PDO2 15V contract), and 5-6 = GND (paired return). The former JST J5 (board-b) used the identical cable pinout; the renewed Board B J5 is a different stacking header. Before using the historical cable interface, verify both pin-1 orientations, end-to-end continuity and actual mating polarization. A polarized housing does not establish correct internal conductor mapping.

With power absent, inspect mating latch/key, tug-test every crimp, continuity-test all six conductors end-to-end, verify no adjacent shorts and duplicate power/ground conductors, then current-limit first power and check connector/wire temperature under maximum intended load (worst-case 3.0 A PD-contract cap against the 1.6x/2.0x derated/nameplate margin).
